title: East Nashville Getaway-10 Min To Broadway, Parking
description:
Experience East Nashville at The Ellington, minutes to local favorites in Five Points for food and music.
- Versatile sleeping for 4
- Free parking with a 1-car garage
- Work-ready with high-speed WiFi dedicated workspace in the first-floor den
- Stylish living area equipped with Smart TVs for streaming
- 2 miles from Broadway and Nissan Stadium
- 24/7 hospitality support

The space
Our home is designed to be both elegant and comfortable, providing a seamless experience from the moment you arrive. Enjoy a fully-equipped kitchen, two distinct living areas, and restful spaces to unwind after a day of exploring.

Sleeping Arrangements (Comfortably sleeps 4-6 guests):
1st Floor Den: Our den features a versatile full-size sleeper sofa.
2nd Floor Primary Suite: Queen-size memory foam mattress for a restful night's sleep.
Additional: An air mattress is available to accommodate up to 6 guests total.

Stylish Living & Working:
The upstairs living room features a chic mid-century leather sofa, perfect for relaxing with your favorite streaming services on the Smart TV.
Downstairs Den: A separate den offers a private workspace with a desk, along with a comfortable sofa and chaise lounge for quiet reflection.
Fully-Equipped Kitchen: The modern kitchen is ready for any culinary exploration, fully outfitted with a Whirlpool stainless steel electric stove and oven.
Free parking: Enjoy your private 1-car garage and free street parking.
Walkability:  Take advantage of the location of your home away from home and walk to local favorites like  Mas Tacos and Pharmacy Burger.

Long Term Living:
Looking for a comfortable, furnished home in Nashville for an extended stay? Whether you're a digital nomad, college student, or settling in as our newest neighbor, we've got you covered. If you're interested, feel free to reach out to learn more! Please take note that there is a refundable security deposit of $500 charged separately before check-in for any reservations between 22 days and 6 months, and a deposit of $1,000 charged separately before check-in for any reservations over 6 months.

The Ellington is less than 12 minutes to Broadway and the Grand Ole Opry, and just minutes to Five Points, a vibrant neighborhood for food, live music, and local shopping. 

PLEASE NOTE: Due to the nature of the Nashville popularity boom, construction recently started near the home. You should expect some construction disruption Monday-Friday between 7am and 7pm.

Permit: CASR 2020_followed by_34746

Guest access
You'll have access to the entire unit and one-car garage!

Other things to note
Welcome to our boutique hospitality experience, led by a close-knit team of husband-and-wife duo and their close friends. We've been making dream vacations come true since 2014 and we're thrilled to do the same for you! We choose our properties with care, only offering places we'd love to stay in ourselves. You'll find top local spots around each location and we're always ready to suggest the best picks tailored just for you.

- Check-In: We provide a unique, custom door code for each stay for secure and easy keyless entry.
- Guest Verification: All guests are required to complete an additional guest verification process after booking, which includes signing a liability agreement.
- Local Bookings: We typically do not host local residents. We may inquire about the purpose of your stay and reserve the right to decline bookings.
- Security Deposit: A refundable security deposit is required for longer stays and is charged separately before check-in. The deposit is $500 for reservations between 22 days and 6 months, and $1,000 for reservations over 6 months.
- Child-Friendly Rentals: If you need a pack and play or high chair, please inquire for a unique link to rent these items.
- 24/7 Support: Our team is available around the clock to help with any questions or personalized requests.
